sync.1_open_this_code:
1. Open this code with a phone (any phone: it does not need to be one of the cameras). Turn its volume up and switch off silent mode.

2. Tap «Start» on the phone (or here, once it is open).

3. When it starts flashing and beeping (like a barcode, about ten times a second), show it to each camera, 3 or 4 seconds each, and let the PC microphone hear it for a while.

4. Over each camera in the mosaic you see «✓ ready» as soon as it is done, and «missing» on the others; below here (and on the phone), how many are missing and how far behind each one is. With all of them, it finishes by itself (or «Finish», on the phone or here). It takes at most {secs} s.

cam-ui measures how long each camera takes to arrive and adjusts its «Delay» and the sound one by itself. The test is not saved.
colordlg.double_click_slider_initial: Double-click a slider = initial value. Mouse wheel or arrow keys to move it, or type the number in its box.
sync.sound_heard_later_sync: + = the sound is heard later. «Sync» sets it by itself (with a phone acting as a clapperboard), together with each camera’s «Delay».
sync.less_buffer_less_delay: Less buffer = less delay. Set 0 if a microphone gives an error when it opens.
cert.on_android_none_this: On Android none of this is needed (with «Advanced → Proceed» in the browser warning it already works). On iPhone/iPad: point the Camera at this code and open the page in Safari (Chrome or another browser only downloads a file that is no use; if it opens in another one, the page tells you what to type in Safari). You only have to do it once.
phones.these_phones_join_by: These phones join by themselves when they open «/add» on this PC, without reading any QR code again. The name is the one their camera will have the next time it connects.

cams.each_drawing_way_arranging: Each drawing is a way of arranging your cameras (by rows or by columns, with each one’s real format). Drag a cell of the map onto another to change which camera goes where.
cams.try_modes_opens_camera: Try modes (opens the camera with each one)
cams.featured_bigger_with_auto: ★ Featured: bigger with the «Auto» layout (up to {n})
frame.like_camera_keeps_its: «Like the camera» keeps its real format: nothing is lost and the canvas adapts. With another shape what does not fit is cropped, and with the zoom and position you choose which part stays. You can type any ratio (e.g. 2.2:1 or 1008:720).
frame.remove_black_bars_from: Remove black bars from the image
frame.double_click_slider_initial: (double-click a slider = initial value; mouse wheel or arrow keys to move it; or type the number in its box)
frame.shows_whole_camera_image: Shows the whole camera image with a frame: drag it to move it and use the mouse wheel to zoom. Esc or «Done» to go back to the mosaic. Also: double-click a camera in the preview.
color.temperature_warmer_orange_cooler: Temperature: + warmer (orange), − cooler (blue). Changes show instantly, also while recording. Double-click = initial value; mouse wheel or arrow keys to move it, or type the number.
color.automatic_exposure_white_balance: Automatic exposure and white balance, focus, gain… are offered by the driver itself, which each manufacturer implements in its own way (ffmpeg can only open its native Windows dialog). Use it to switch off the automatic settings so the image does not «breathe».
audio.each_output_channel_fed: Each output channel is fed from the device and source channel you choose. E.g.: mic A to the left and mic B to the right.
out.fitted_content_makes_video: «Fitted to the content» makes a video with just the right shape so that no camera loses anything (e.g. two 4:3 on top and one 16:9 below). With a fixed format (16:9, 9:16…) the mosaic is centred and filled with black bars.
out.mkv_safer_if_program: MKV is safer if the program closes halfway through a recording.
out.offers_mosaic_as_one: Offers the mosaic as one more camera (choose «OBS Virtual Camera» in Teams, Zoom, Meet…); also in the tray, the «Mode» menu and, in compact and mini, the 📹 button. It needs OBS Studio installed and the pyvirtualcam package. Video only, no audio; the mosaic is centred with black bars in 16:9. Only one program can use that camera at a time.
out.on_network_watch_from: On the network (watch it from another computer or phone)
out.size_maximum_sent_with: «Size» is the maximum: it is sent with the same shape as the mosaic here (with its framing, without adding black bars), as big as fits, and never bigger than the mosaic itself -- so another cam-ui that adds it as a «network camera» receives it with the same format and the same fps as the mosaic (up to 30). A bigger maximum gives more resolution in exchange for more wifi (at 1280 wide and 30 fps, about 40 Mbit/s). Open that address in the browser of another computer or phone on the same network (wifi) to watch the mosaic live, with full screen; also in the tray, the «Mode» menu and, in compact and mini, the 🌐 button (clicking the address in the status bar opens it directly). If a microphone is on it can also be heard («Turn on sound» button on the page, with its own volume control). For watching only: nobody can control cam-ui from there, and it is independent of recording and of the virtual camera (they can be used at the same time). No password: anyone on that network can watch it (and hear it) while it is on. The first time, Windows may ask for permission in the firewall: give it for «private networks». «Open in VLC» (if it is installed) opens it there instead of in the browser; from VLC’s own menu Playback -> Renderer it can be sent to a Chromecast on the same network -- VLC does the conversion by itself, with nothing else to install here. VLC cannot send to AirPlay (it only exists as a feature of macOS itself).
out.phone_camera_from_its: Phone camera (from its browser, nothing to install)
out.always_on_on_phone: Always on: on the phone, go to any of the addresses below (with «/movil» or «/add» at the end) and tap «Scan»: as soon as it grants camera permission, a QR code will appear right here for it to read with the phone’s own camera -- as soon as it reads it, it is added to the mosaic by itself, without touching anything else here. The first time the browser will warn that the connection «is not private» -- that is normal (it is your own cam-ui, not a real website): tap «Advanced» and «Proceed». For now video only, without the phone’s sound. Having to see the QR on the PC screen is what really protects this: nobody on the wifi can add themselves without being in front of the computer (except with the password below, if you set one). With no phone connected it hardly uses any resources (it only listens on the port, like «On the network»).
out.on_iphone_ipad_one: On iPhone/iPad one more step is needed (button above, only once): Safari does not allow the camera there without it, however much you accept the «connection not private» warning -- that is enough to see the page, but not for the camera. On Android none of this is needed.
out.phone_that_has_already: A phone that has already paired once (with the usual QR) joins by itself the next time it opens that same address, without reading any code again -- here you can see which ones (type and last connection), and rename them or «forget» them.
out.optional_alternative_qr_on: Optional: an alternative to the QR. On the phone’s page, «🔑 Use password» and this same password add it without having to read anything on this screen. Empty, only with the QR. Whoever knows it and is on the same wifi can add their camera: make it hard to guess. After 5 failed attempts, that phone has to wait (longer each time), and if many fail at once, the password stops being accepted for a while (the QR still works).
out.common_clock_lines_up: «Common clock» lines up all the cameras and the audio on a single timeline. «Device timestamps» trusts the time each camera gives: with the usual engine, one that gives it wrong slows down the whole mosaic. With the new engine it does not count: always the common clock.
out.new_engine_each_camera: New engine: each camera on its own (recommended)
out.opens_all_cameras_at: Opens all the cameras at once, each on its own: a slow one (10 fps), one that drops out or another PC’s one no longer slow down the others, and restarting the mosaic or starting to record does not open them again. Another cam-ui’s one is lined up by the time it was captured there. If something gets worse, untick it and the usual engine comes back (a single ffmpeg for all).
netcam.name: Name
netcam.address_given_by_phone: The address given by the phone app (e.g. «IP Webcam» on Android): something like http://192.168.1.50:8080/video, or by rtsp rtsp://192.168.1.50:8080/h264_ulaw.sdp. The «network output» address of another PC with cam-ui also works -- the full URL, ending in /stream.mjpg (something like http://192.168.1.50:8554/stream.mjpg) -- to chain several computers. The other device and this computer must be on the same wifi network, and the other PC must have «On the network» turned on. Video only, no audio. If this camera is slow or jerky: the resolution it arrives with cannot be chosen here, but if the source is another PC with cam-ui, in ITS Settings → «On the network» → size the one it sends can be lowered -- it is lighter to receive here without touching anything on this computer.
netcam.url_must_start_with: The URL must start with http://, https:// or rtsp://

diag.preview_pauses_for_about:
The preview pauses for about 30 s and each device is measured (real fps of each camera, audio drop-outs) first separately and then all at once.

That shows whether the problem is a camera, the microphone or sharing the USB/CPU.
